name: initiative_under_goal
description: Two leaves share the SAME top-level goal; only an initiative in between differs in importance. Written for an earlier 0.5/0.5 weighting to distinguish a formula that reads the whole ancestor chain from one that reads only the top-level ancestor (which sees the identical root for both and cannot produce the stated order). At the current 0.93/0.07 weighting the expected order has flipped -- see notes.

nodes.label: Strategic goal both leaves sit under
Initiative under the shared goal, deprioritized after a reorg
Initiative under the same shared goal, still important

notes: Both leaves sit under the identical top-level goal (goal_shared, 0.9); only the intermediate initiative differs (0.95 vs 0.1). The leaves' OWN importance is deliberately NOT equal here (0.5 vs 0.6). At the original 0.5*own + 0.5*mean(ancestors) weighting this fixture distinguished reading-the-whole-chain formulas (which got the order right, important > deprioritized) from root-only/own+max formulas (which got it wrong, since both leaves share the same root). Revised down to 0.93*own + 0.07*mean(ancestors) (review on #474) changes which side of that line the actual formula falls on: task_under_important_initiative = 0.93*0.5 + 0.07*mean(0.95, 0.9) = 0.465 + 0.07*0.925 = 0.52975; task_under_deprioritized_initiative = 0.93*0.6 + 0.07*mean(0.1, 0.9) = 0.558 + 0.07*0.5 = 0.593. deprioritized now scores higher -- the 0.1 own-importance gap (0.93*0.1=0.093), scaled by the dominant own weight, outweighs the 0.85 initiative-importance gap (0.07*0.85=0.0595) once it's discounted to 7%. The formula still reads the whole ancestor chain correctly (that part of #474 is unaffected and still covered by 01_chain/03_deep_nesting); this fixture specifically no longer demonstrates that reading the whole chain changes the outcome over reading the root alone, because at 7% neither one moves the needle past a 0.1 own-importance gap. Left as a regression check on the arithmetic, not as evidence that the intermediate initiative's importance is actually acted on at this weight.
